mapper.select: SELECT m.MATCH_ID, m.HOME_TEAM_ID, m.AWAY_TEAM_ID, m.HOME_SCORE, m.AWAY_SCORE, m.STATUS, m.MATCH_DATE, ht.TEAM_NAME AS homeTeamName, ht.TEAM_NAME_KOR AS homeTeamNameKor, ht.EMBLEM_URL AS homeEmblemUrl, at.TEAM_NAME AS awayTeamName, at.TEAM_NAME_KOR AS awayTeamNameKor, at.EMBLEM_URL AS awayEmblemUrl FROM MATCHES m JOIN TEAMS ht ON m.HOME_TEAM_ID = ht.TEAM_ID JOIN TEAMS at ON m.AWAY_TEAM_ID = at.TEAM_ID WHERE m.MATCH_ID = #{matchId}
SELECT p.PREDICTION_ID, p.USER_ID, p.MATCH_ID, p.PREDICT_RESULT, p.IS_SUCCESS, p.CREATED_AT FROM PREDICTIONS p WHERE p.USER_ID = #{userId} AND p.MATCH_ID = #{matchId}
SELECT u.POINT FROM USERS u WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PREDICTIONS ( USER_ID, MATCH_ID, PREDICT_RESULT, IS_SUCCESS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{matchId}, #{predictResult}, NULL, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET POINT = POINT + #{amount}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POINT_HISTORY ( USER_ID, PREDICTION_ID, AMOUNT, BALANCE_AFTER, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{predictionId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{description}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT p.PREDICTION_ID, p.USER_ID, p.MATCH_ID, p.PREDICT_RESULT, p.IS_SUCCESS, p.CREATED_AT, m.MATCH_DATE, m.STATUS AS matchStatus, m.HOME_SCORE, m.AWAY_SCORE, ht.TEAM_NAME AS homeTeamName, ht.TEAM_NAME_KOR AS homeTeamNameKor, ht.EMBLEM_URL AS homeEmblemUrl, at.TEAM_NAME AS awayTeamName, at.TEAM_NAME_KOR AS awayTeamNameKor, at.EMBLEM_URL AS awayEmblemUrl FROM PREDICTIONS p JOIN MATCHES m ON p.MATCH_ID = m.MATCH_ID JOIN TEAMS ht ON m.HOME_TEAM_ID = ht.TEAM_ID JOIN TEAMS at ON m.AWAY_TEAM_ID = at.TEAM_ID WHERE p.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY p.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalVotes, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN PREDICT_RESULT = 'HOME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS homeVotes, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN PREDICT_RESULT = 'DRAW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS drawVotes, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN PREDICT_RESULT = 'AWAY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS awayVotes FROM PREDICTIONS WHERE MATCH_ID = #{matchId}
SELECT p.PREDICTION_ID, p.USER_ID, p.MATCH_ID, p.PREDICT_RESULT, p.IS_SUCCESS, p.CREATED_AT FROM PREDICTIONS p WHERE p.MATCH_ID = #{matchId} AND p.IS_SUCCESS IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE PREDICTIONS SET PREDICT_RESULT = #{predictResult}, CREATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE PREDICTION_ID = #{predictionId}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO USER_PREDICTS up USING ( SELECT #{userId} AS USER_ID FROM DUAL ) s ON (up.USER_ID = s.USER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET up.PREDICT_TOTAL = up.PREDICT_TOTAL + 1, up.PREDICT_WIN = up.PREDICT_WIN + #{winIncrement}, up.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( USER_ID, PREDICT_WIN, PREDICT_TOTAL, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{winIncrement}, 1, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT up.USER_ID, up.PREDICT_WIN, up.PREDICT_TOTAL, up.UPDATED_AT, u.NICKNAME FROM USER_PREDICTS up JOIN USERS u ON up.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE up.PREDICT_TOTAL >= 1 AND u.ROLE_CODE != 7 ORDER BY up.PREDICT_WIN DESC, (up.PREDICT_WIN / NULLIF(up.PREDICT_TOTAL, 0)) DESC, up.UPDATED_AT ASC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
